policy.briefingRule: Only source records with publishedAt less than or equal to the chapter cutoff may be exposed before commitment.
policy.sourcePreference: Primary issuer, regulator, government or intergovernmental sources.
policy.quotationRule: Store an original short summary and link; do not copy long source passages into the client.

sources.title: Microsoft and OpenAI extend partnership
sources.supportedClaim: Microsoft described a multiyear, multibillion-dollar OpenAI investment and Azure as the exclusive cloud provider.

sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2023
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA reported quarterly results, described an AI inflection point and disclosed year-over-year revenue decline.

sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for First Quarter Fiscal 2024
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA guided approximately $11 billion in second-quarter fiscal 2024 revenue.

sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2024
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA reported data-center growth and guided approximately $16 billion in third-quarter fiscal 2024 revenue.

sources.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Platform Arrives to Power a New Era of Computing
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA introduced Blackwell as a platform and named cloud, server and software ecosystem participants.

sources.title: Micron Commences Volume Production of Industry-Leading HBM3E Solution
sources.supportedClaim: Micron said it began HBM3E volume production and that the product would be used in NVIDIA H200 GPUs.

sources.title: SK hynix to Produce DRAM From M15X in Cheongju
sources.supportedClaim: SK hynix announced a major M15X investment intended to expand HBM and next-generation DRAM production.

sources.title: Micron investor presentation — HBM supply allocation
sources.supportedClaim: Micron stated that its calendar 2024 and 2025 HBM output was sold out.

sources.title: SK hynix Begins Volume Production of the World's First 12-Layer HBM3E
sources.supportedClaim: SK hynix announced volume production of a 12-layer HBM3E product.

sources.title: SK hynix Ships World's First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers
sources.supportedClaim: SK hynix said it shipped 12-layer HBM4 samples to major customers and planned mass-production preparation.

sources.title: SK hynix Completes World's First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production
sources.supportedClaim: SK hynix said it completed HBM4 development and established a mass-production system.

sources.title: Electricity 2024
sources.supportedClaim: The IEA projected that combined electricity consumption from data centres, AI and crypto could more than double by 2026.

sources.title: Vertiv Reports First Quarter 2024 Results
sources.supportedClaim: Vertiv reported 60% organic orders growth and disclosed backlog and updated outlook.

sources.title: Vertiv Reports Strong Third Quarter 2024 Results
sources.supportedClaim: Vertiv reported results, hyperscale demand commentary and raised full-year guidance.

sources.title: Energy and AI
sources.supportedClaim: The IEA projected global data-centre electricity consumption to around 945 TWh by 2030 in its base case.

sources.title: NVIDIA 800 V HVDC Architecture Will Power the Next Generation of AI Factories
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA described an 800 VDC power architecture for future high-density AI factories.

sources.title: Building the 800 VDC Ecosystem for Efficient, Scalable AI Factories
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA described the 800 VDC ecosystem and a transition path from prevailing AC distribution.

sources.title: Data centre electricity use surged in 2025
sources.supportedClaim: The IEA reported that data-centre electricity consumption increased in 2025 and discussed connection bottlenecks.

sources.title: Broadcom Delivers Industry's First 51.2 Tbps Co-Packaged Optics Ethernet Switch
sources.supportedClaim: Broadcom announced a 51.2 Tbps co-packaged optics Ethernet switch platform.

sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Spectrum-X and Quantum-X Photonics Networking Switches
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA announced photonics switches, planned availability and named manufacturing and optical ecosystem participants.

sources.title: Broadcom Advances Optical Connectivity for AI Infrastructure
sources.supportedClaim: Broadcom described advances across co-packaged optics, DSP and optical connectivity.

sources.title: Broadcom Announces Third-Generation Co-Packaged Optics
sources.supportedClaim: Broadcom introduced third-generation 200G-per-lane CPO and described production milestones.

sources.title: Broadcom Ships Tomahawk 6, the World's First 102.4 Tbps Switch
sources.supportedClaim: Broadcom said Tomahawk 6 was shipping and described support for co-packaged optics.

sources.title: Scaling Power-Efficient AI Factories with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA described Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics design and efficiency goals for AI factories.

sources.title: Coherent Expands Texas Manufacturing for AI Optical Technologies
sources.supportedClaim: NVIDIA described Coherent breaking ground on expanded Texas manufacturing for AI optical technology.

sources.title: Nebius to Triple Capacity at Finland Data Center to 75 MW
sources.supportedClaim: Nebius announced a plan to triple capacity at its Finland data centre to 75 MW within a wider investment programme.

sources.title: Nebius Group Confirms Resumption of Trading on Nasdaq
sources.supportedClaim: Nebius said NBIS trading was scheduled to resume at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on 21 October 2024.

sources.title: Applied Digital Announces 250MW AI Data Center Lease With CoreWeave
sources.supportedClaim: Applied Digital announced a 250 MW, approximately 15-year lease with CoreWeave.

sources.title: Applied Digital Finalizes Additional 150MW Lease With CoreWeave
sources.supportedClaim: Applied Digital said an additional 150 MW brought CoreWeave-leased capacity to 400 MW.

sources.title: Nebius Announces Multi-Billion-Dollar Agreement With Microsoft for AI Infrastructure
sources.supportedClaim: Nebius announced a multibillion-dollar AI infrastructure agreement with Microsoft.

sources.title: Applied Digital Achieves Ready for Service for Phase 1 at Polaris Forge 1
sources.supportedClaim: Applied Digital said the first 50 MW phase at Polaris Forge 1 reached ready-for-service.

sources.title: IREN Signs $9.7 Billion Agreement With Microsoft
sources.supportedClaim: IREN announced a five-year Microsoft agreement with stated contract value and planned 200 MW deployment.

sources.title: Nebius Signs New AI Infrastructure Agreement With Meta
sources.supportedClaim: Nebius announced a Meta agreement with dedicated capacity and additional conditional capacity components.

sources.title: TeraWulf Announces Anthropic Lease at Justified Data Campus
sources.supportedClaim: TeraWulf announced a long-term Anthropic lease with 401 MW of planned capacity and phased future delivery.

sources.title: IREN Delivers Horizon 1 to Microsoft
sources.supportedClaim: IREN said Horizon 1, 50 MW, was delivered to and accepted by Microsoft; the release does not establish billing commencement.
